title: Premarket · Wednesday 9/30

headline.title: HPE released its investor day before the event and it is a raise. FY27 Networking revenue growth to high teens–low 20s, segment margin mid-to-high 20s, Juniper synergies up to $800M from at least $600M — plus a first AMD Helios order, $1.2B from Vultr. +4.90% at 64.50, and the presentation is still ahead at 10:30.
headline.summary: That is the exact shape the backtest warns about. HPE's last analyst meeting, Oct 15 2025, ran +5.2% intraday during the webcast, closed flat, then fell 10.1% the next session. This time the news is out before the event, so the pop is already spent by the open. 65.65 — Friday's high — is $1.15 above and remains the level.

overview:
Five things land today. PCE 7:30 with final GDP, ADP 7:15, quarter-end, the funding deadline, and MU after the close with an analyst day.

The rate picture moved yesterday. Williams said “no need for urgency” and October odds fell from above 70% to 40–50%. 10-year down 2bp to 5.22%.

Yesterday's calls held. CCL closed +13.4% on 75.5M shares, triple its pace, ORB intact all day. AAOI +4.0%. SPY never reclaimed 766.29, as the correction said. MDB triggered at 344.30, ran 349.00, closed 337.19 — fired and failed.

Also: BA +2.6% on a $20B+ Navy F/A-XX win. HOOD +4.7% on Robinhood Agents. MRNA −7.3%, Citi to Sell.

darkpool.note: No fresh board for this session. What carries in is Micron: it has topped the single-name print board three sessions running into tonight — $1.0B at the bid Friday, $936.1M at the ask Monday, and it tops cumulative flow at $5.1B (ask) ahead of NVDA $4.8B (mixed) and META $3.7B (ask). That is roughly $2B of single-print size worked through in two sessions, on both sides, into a binary event. Positioning, not a forecast. The rest of Monday's top ten was half semis — MU, AVGO, MRVL, NVDA and LRCX all drew size the night before this print, and every one of them crossed after hours. Tuesday's morning tape was the opposite character: ORCL $91.3M bid, CAT $50.0M bid, AMGN $50.0M, with AMGN topping the six-session flow-leaders list at $291.0M. Defensives and infrastructure catching size the day before PCE.
darkpool.right_note: MU's $1000C dated 10/02 is deep in the money with the stock at 1,081 and the print landing tonight — the sweep placed two days past the earnings date, now two sessions from expiry. Largest block on Monday's board was WPM $54.5M puts, crossing as the metals led the down-movers.
